description: This file provides a class and functions for handling code auto-completion, specifically for filling code holes marked as '{{FILL_HERE}}'. It includes parsing responses with <COMPLETION> tags, generating prompts, and interacting with a language model for suggestions.

classes.name: HoleFiller
classes.description: A class responsible for generating prompts, parsing responses, and interacting with a language model to fill code holes marked as '{{FILL_HERE}}'.

methods.name: parseGhostResponse
methods.description: Parses a full response string to extract content within <COMPLETION> tags and returns a FillInAtCursorSuggestion object.

methods.name: getPrompts
methods.description: Generates a prompt object containing system instructions and user prompt for the hole-filling task.

methods.name: getSystemInstructions
methods.description: Returns the instructions string guiding the model on how to fill holes.

methods.name: getUserPrompt
methods.description: Builds a prompt string with context snippets and instructions for auto-completion.

methods.name: getFromChat
methods.description: Executes a chat-based completion request to the model, processes the response, and returns a structured result with the suggestion.
